notes: TakeProfitHook extends the locally modified OpenZeppelin LimitOrderHook. Its sole constructor argument is the approved Sepolia PoolManager; LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. Only afterInitialize and afterSwap are enabled, giving address bits 0x1040 under mask 0x3FFF, validated by the hook constructor; the factory mines the CREATE2 salt. The intended pool has native ETH as currency0 and TKPF as currency1, with a 0.30% LP fee and spacing 60. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 from TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(138000), matching test/BaseHookTest.sol's starting price and token-only seed fixture. Orders sell TKPF for ETH over [tick, tick + 60], with the lower tick a multiple of 60 strictly below the current range. ETH-selling orders are rejected. Partial crossings remain active; fully crossed orders hold proceeds as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims for pull withdrawal. State is isolated by PoolId; the hook is not bound to a single token. Callbacks are PoolManager-only, with no administrative, pause or upgrade path. afterSwap iterates over every crossed spacing interval; gas measurements and accounting changes are documented in docs/GAS.md and docs/REVIEW.md. ABI exports are docs/abi/TakeProfitHook.json and docs/abi/LaunchToken.json. This manifest is a technical description; launch policy and signed artifact linkage are supplied separately by services. Independent review, publication, attestation, admission, deployment and the frontend are separate stage outcomes.
